github.title: Discrete CIP and VRP with Governance
github.body:
## Discrete CIP and VRP with Governance Staking

### Summary
Implement discrete **CIP (Creator Incentive Pool)** and **VRP (Validator Reward Pool)** as separate ledger accounts with waterfall-priority funding from Treasury. Add **governance staking** as a Z1U sink mechanism that locks tokens and reduces circulating supply pressure.

### What this covers
- **CIP:** A dedicated pool that funds content creators based on quality-weighted distribution. Treasury fills CIP each epoch according to a waterfall priority (after ops costs, before buybacks).
- **VRP:** A dedicated pool that funds validators/verifiers with stake-weighted rewards. Separate funding line from CIP to prevent cross-contamination of incentive budgets.
- **Governance Staking:** Users lock Z1U into a staking contract to participate in governance. Staked Z1U acts as a sink (removed from circulating supply), reducing settlement pressure on the Audience Reserve.

### Tokenomics Persona Obligations
- **Supply/Emissions:** Define CIP and VRP funding rates per epoch and their impact on Treasury drain
- **Incentive Source:** Trace which pool funds which agent class (creators vs validators)
- **Liquidity/Treasury/Governance Authority:** Document who controls pool parameters and staking APY
- **Financial Advisory Boundary:** Staking APY claims require qualified review before publication

### Stories
- US-Z1-M3-05: Discrete VRP + CIP pools with waterfall priority
- US-Z1-M3-06: Governance staking as Z1U sink

---
